retention_tricks: Rapid Cuts/Pacing: Keep editing fast, change scenes every 1-3 seconds.
Visual Curiosity Loops: Show a glimpse of what's coming next, then reveal it.
Sound Design: Use trending sounds, sound effects, and escalating music to build tension.
On-screen Text Overlays: Reinforce key points or add comedic/sarcastic elements.
Story Arc (Mini): Introduce a problem, offer a solution, show the result.
Direct Addressing: Speak directly to the viewer, asking rhetorical questions.
